_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-36 base rate on ±2+ point score moves confirms this is a tight coil, so the statistically honest call is HOLD with low conviction until the breaker (short squeeze + ETF inflows) actually fires.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst calls UP with low conviction citing short-squeeze potential; narrative implies UP via bottom analog framing, but neither provides statistically robust evidence of an imminent breaker.
next_move.confirmed_if: funding rises above 0.015% with btc_momentum_30d clearing 65 and long_short_pct_30d climbing above 20
next_move.invalidated_if: fed_liquidity stays pinned at 0 while btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d drops below 70 and funding goes negative
